profile.name: Andrzej Błażejowski
profile.title: Middle / acting as Senior Frontend Developer
profile.summary: Frontend engineer with 10+ years of experience building web applications, Smart TV/STB platforms, and cross-platform IPTV/VOD frameworks. Specialized in React, TypeScript, and Next.js with a track record of legacy migrations, performance optimization, and technical leadership across international telecom and food-delivery products.

employments.company: The Better Software Group / Spyrosoft BSG
employments.role: Middle / acting as Senior Frontend Developer

projects.title: Global QSR Franchise Operator – Multi-Market Food(mostly pizza) Delivery Platform
projects.summary: Modernisation of a high-traffic food delivery web application for a leading European restaurant group operating a major international pizza brand across 3 markets, improving maintainability and cost-effectiveness.
highlights: Legacy Migration: Upgraded application from Next.js 9 to 16+, Node 14 to 24+, and React 16 to 19, Leaflet raster tiles to MapTiler vector tiles eliminating technical debt.
SEO Optimization: Increased visibility by implementing dynamic sitemaps and URL-accessible subpages.
Application Maintenance & Stability: Maintained the application, reducing critical SLA issues by ~90% YoY.

projects.title: Global QSR Franchise Operator – In-Store Self-Order Kiosk Analytics(mostly burger and fried-chicken brands)
projects.summary: Took ownership of an in-store kiosk analytics system for a leading restaurant franchise operator (major burger and fried-chicken brands), driving integration and delivery to production.
highlights: Business Intelligence Integration: Implemented user-behavior analytics system to optimise business ROI.
Technical Leadership: Mentored engineers on performance and introduced architectural improvements.
Quality Assurance & Coverage: Established tracking standards, successfully raising and maintaining data analytics coverage at a 95%+ level.

projects.title: BSG Innovation Lab
projects.summary: Greenfield development of a Proof of Concept (POC) VOD application for Tizen Smart TV and RDK environments.
highlights: Team Upskilling & Mentoring: Mentored a 3-engineer team from scratch on LightningJS and RDK.
Architecture & Tooling: Designed core codebase architecture, repository structure, and linting/styling standards.
Performance Optimisation: Optimized the application to ensure consistent 60 FPS on hardware-constrained Smart TV/STB platforms.

projects.title: Enterprise IPTV/VOD Platform – Cross-Platform White-Label Framework
projects.summary: Contributed to a cross-platform, white-label IPTV/VOD framework deployed across set-top boxes, PCs, and smartphones for tier-1 international telecom operators across Nordic, Balkans, and Mediterranean markets.
highlights: Contract Delivery & Revenue Retention: Resolved legacy flaws (race conditions, network resilience issues), securing a major contract milestone.
Cross-Platform Core Development: Co-created the multi-platform framework, including a unified Design System and TV navigation.
Performance Engineering: Designed memory management strategies and adaptive animation scaling for low-end STBs.

projects.title: Enterprise Video Player SDK – Roku Platform
projects.summary: Co-developed a commercial VOD player SDK for the Roku platform from the ground up as part of a 2-engineer team.
highlights: SDK Architecture & API Alignment: Engineered core BrightScript structure, aligning the public API with web/mobile standards.
Advanced Video Capabilities: Implemented DRM protection, closed captions, Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (ABR), and programmatic video ad integration.
Test Automation Integration: Architected automated testing via MQTT protocols for remote player control and metadata collection.
Technical Documentation: Authored developer documentation, tutorials, and reference apps for enterprise integrators.

projects.title: Medical Fleet Management Platform
projects.summary: Contributed to the development and production support of an enterprise fleet management and route optimization platform tailored for time-critical medical logistics and courier networks.
highlights: Real-Time Route Customization: Engineered a core map feature using Leaflet that allowed dispatchers to dynamically recalculate and edit delivery routes in real-time while couriers were already in transit.
Database Performance Optimization: Analyzed and optimized complex PL/SQL database queries and procedures, reducing data retrieval times.
Geospatial Data Filtering: Implemented advanced route and path filtering systems within the map interface for hundreds of concurrent medical deliveries.
Localization & Internationalization: Standardized application data processing with dynamic floating-point and numerical format switching for cross-regional compatibility.

projects.title: The appCreate – No-Code / App Builder
projects.summary: Took ownership of a web-based mobile app builder platform mid-development after the previous developer's departure, successfully driving the product to its first stable production release.
highlights: Administration Panel Development: Developed the web admin panel, integrating it with RESTful API to allow non-technical clients to dynamically configure and manage mobile apps.
Dynamic UI Layouts: Engineered reusable templates and dynamic views using Handlebars.js and jQuery, enabling diverse application types (hotel guides, city garbage schedules, radio streaming apps).

projects.title: SME Web Solutions
projects.summary: Developed and maintained dynamic websites and custom web solutions tailored for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) using Drupal CMS and modern frontend workflows.
highlights: End-to-End Website Delivery: Successfully built and delivered 5 custom websites from scratch utilizing Drupal 7, ensuring cross-browser compatibility, responsive layouts, and optimized loading speeds.
Design-to-Code Implementation: Transformed complex PSD mockups into pixel-perfect, semantic Drupal themes and templates.
Interactive Features: Integrated custom JavaScript/jQuery functionalities and PhysicsJS for advanced browser-based physics animations.
Website Maintenance & Support: Managed ongoing updates, security patches, and functional enhancements for existing client websites.
